scope: Q4 target/Q4 DFlash2, C1: exact Q4_K FFN projections at verification widths3–8. Weights, FP32 accumulation/reduction order, scalar decoding, sampling and draft controller unchanged.
retained: Q4_K FFN down5120x17408 at widths3–8 uses W16/R4/Tiles2/MinWaves4/Narrow; gate/up17408x5120 selects the same layout at widths3/4/7/8. Width5/6 gate/up keeps W16/R3/Tiles2/MinWaves12/Narrow.

Compact staging removes four padding floats per16-element sub-block and applies the existing float4 permutation. No activation or weight precision change. New specialization perwidth reuses the existing exact kernel body.
The maintained projection tool includes the Q4 four-row geometry; partial M67/K768 controls cover every width3–8. No runtime execution switches or extra test executable.

quality.scope_note: Q8 target and Q8/BF16 draft suites were not rerun for this Q4-only route change; their prior qualification remains in dflash2-middle-projections.json.

actual_weight_confirmation.method: Independent confirmation: Q4 actual GGUF FFNs, production shape versus compact/permuted LDS with three/four rows at unchanged FP32 arithmetic. Six rotated-order rounds, six full rotations of up to16 matrices; all tensor outputs finite and bit exact.

initial_layout_screen.method: Q4 actual GGUF FFNs, production shape versus compact/permuted LDS with three/four rows at unchanged FP32 arithmetic. Six rotated-order rounds, six full rotations of up to16 matrices; all tensor outputs finite and bit exact.

speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, no separate warmup. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

profile.method: Separate rocprofv3 release runs, Q4/Q4 raw JSON/prose TG300. Selected Q4 FFN kernel/grid unions have identical call counts. At widths3/4, the baseline down-projection group shares a kernel/grid with unchanged M5120 projections; include the corresponding unchanged candidate group rather than pretending these are isolated down-only measurements. Grids are total threads, not block counts. Timings are diagnostic, not headline rates.

rejected_experiments.method: Same actual Q5 tensor bytes and arithmetic; production versus early decoded weights, early packed weights, and early packed weights plus scales. Six rotating orders and six matrix rotations, bit exact check all variants and tensors.
rejected_experiments.decision: No production change: no repeatable gain across these three Q5 batch8 projections.

rejected_experiments.method: Actual Q5 GGUF tensors. Scalar byte header loads versus vector full-header or packed-scale word loads; six rotated-order rounds and six matrix rotations; finite and bit-exact all outputs.
rejected_experiments.decision: No production change: no repeatable gain across these three Q5 batch8 projections.

rejected_experiments.result: Compact rows4/tile2 loses1.09% at width5 and gains only0.89% at width6. Retain the existing route for both; the down projection improves.

limits: Bounded C1 probe, two timed samples per binary/workload, no statistical significance claim. No new pp2048, depth sweep, C>1 or independent capability result.
Largest microbenchmark gain is19.3%; measured end-to-end gain is0.37–0.59%. Total profiled prose GPU time is flat; use unprofiled measurements for throughput.
The upstream performance goal remains open. The audited headline uses different weight artifacts/power and excludes prefill; see llama-comparison.json.
